<style>/* WEB_BASE_V1 - the app's type, cards and buttons on the web. Colours only via tokens.css (from AppPalette).
   Fonts as APP_FONT_V2: Exo 2 for Latin and digits; Burmese in Noto Sans Myanmar one weight lighter
   (it carries more ink); letter spacing 0 for Burmese (TRACKING_OFF_MY_V1). */

@font-face { font-family: "Exo 2"; font-weight: 400; font-display: swap; src: url("@@asset2@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Exo 2"; font-weight: 500; font-display: swap; src: url("@@asset3@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Exo 2"; font-weight: 600; font-display: swap; src: url("@@asset4@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Exo 2"; font-weight: 700; font-display: swap; src: url("@@asset5@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Exo 2"; font-weight: 800; font-display: swap; src: url("@@asset6@@") format("woff2"); }
/* "Noto Sans Myanmar VP": the app's weight map (800 -> 700, 600/700 -> 500, 500 -> 400), Myanmar block only */
@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 400; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset7@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 500; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset7@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 600; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset8@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 700; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset8@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 800; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset9@@") format("woff2"); }

:root {
  --font: "Exo 2", "Noto Sans Myanmar VP", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --radius: 20px;
  --radius-sm: 14px;
  --pill: 999px;
  --gutter: 16px;
  --max: 1120px;
  --t-state: 300ms;      /* the app's state changes */
  --t-breathe: 1500ms;   /* power button breathing */
  --t-stagger: 160ms;    /* cards in: 560 ms + 160 ms each */
  --t-enter: 560ms;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
body {
  margin: 0; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--text); background: linear-gradient(var(--page-top), var(--page-bottom)) fixed, var(--page);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; transition: background-color var(--t-state), color var(--t-state);
}
:lang(my), [lang="my"] { letter-spacing: 0 !important; line-height: 1.8; }
/* Burmese glyphs read about one size larger than Exo 2 at the same px: headings one step down, taller lines */
:lang(my) h1 { font-size: clamp(28px, 4.8vw, 48px); line-height: 1.45; }
:lang(my) h2 { font-size: clamp(22px, 3.2vw, 32px); line-height: 1.5; }
:lang(my) h3 { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.6; }
:lang(my) .eyebrow { text-transform: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
a { color: var(--accent-ink); text-decoration: none; }
a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

h1, h2, h3 { margin: 0 0 .4em; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(34px, 6vw, 60px); }
h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 40px); }
h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }
p { margin: 0 0 1em; color: var(--text-2); }
.eyebrow { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-ink); }
.muted { color: var(--text-3); }
.accent { color: var(--accent); }

.wrap { width: 100%; max-width: var(--max); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--gutter); }
section { padding: 72px 0; }

/* the app's Light card: white, hairline border, one soft shadow, radius 20; Dark: glass */
.card {
  background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--card-shadow); padding: 24px;
}
[data-theme="dark"] .card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { [data-theme="auto"] .card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); } }

.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px;
  padding: 0 24px; border-radius: var(--pill); border: 1px solid transparent; font: inherit; font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--t-state) var(--ease), background-color var(--t-state), box-shadow var(--t-state);
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
.btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }
.btn-primary { background: var(--accent-ink); color: var(--on-accent); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(21,128,61,.28); } /* the app's Renew / Server green (home_screen V55: accentInk) */
.btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }
.btn-ghost { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border); }
.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }

.pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: var(--pill);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--accent-wash); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.pill .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); }

.ink { background: var(--ink); color: var(--text-on-ink); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.ink p { color: rgba(242,251,245,.8); }

/* power button (the app's START / STOP) with its 1.5 s breathing glow */
.power {
  --size: 168px; width: var(--size); height: var(--size); border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, var(--success), var(--accent-ink) 70%);
  color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px var(--accent-wash), 0 18px 40px rgba(34,197,94,.35);
  animation: breathe var(--t-breathe) ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
.power svg { width: 44%; height: 44%; }
@keyframes breathe {
  from { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px var(--accent-wash), 0 14px 32px rgba(34,197,94,.28); }
  to   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 18px var(--accent-wash), 0 22px 48px rgba(34,197,94,.42); }
}

/* cards entering as the app's home: 560 ms + 160 ms per card */
.enter { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
.enter.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: opacity var(--t-enter) var(--ease), transform var(--t-enter) var(--ease);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * var(--t-stagger)); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
  .enter { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}
</style>
<style>/* WEB_SITE_V1 - layout of www.vpnportal.org on top of base.css. Colours only via tokens. */

.skip { position: absolute; left: -999px; top: 8px; background: var(--surface); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; z-index: 50; }
.skip:focus { left: 8px; }
.small { font-size: 14px; }
.center { text-align: center; }
.center img.mid { margin: 0 auto; }
.narrow { max-width: 760px; }
.lead { font-size: 18px; max-width: 620px; }
.tight { padding: 24px 0 72px; }
.page-head { padding: 64px 0 24px; }

/* header */
.top { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--page) 86%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.top-in { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; height: 64px; }
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--text); font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; text-decoration: none !important; }
.brand img { border-radius: 8px; }
.nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-left: 12px; }
.nav a { color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text); background: var(--overlay-2); }
.tools { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.lang { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-2); padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-alt); }
.seg button { border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-2); cursor: pointer; }
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--card-shadow); }
[data-theme="dark"] .seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
.menu { display: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); cursor: pointer; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 10px; }
.menu span { display: block; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; }
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .menu { display: inline-flex; }
  .nav { display: none; position: absolute; top: 64px; left: 0; right: 0; flex-direction: column; padding: 8px var(--gutter) 16px;
    background: var(--page); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); margin: 0; }
  .nav.open { display: flex; }
  .seg { display: none; }
  .nav.open + .tools .seg { display: inline-flex; }
}
@media (max-width: 420px) { .brand span { display: none; } }

/* hero: sticky stage, the phone connects as you scroll (power off -> on, mascot off -> on, rings) */
.hero { position: relative; height: 210vh; padding: 0; }
.hero-sticky { position: sticky; top: 64px; height: calc(100vh - 64px); min-height: 560px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-size: cover; background-position: center top; opacity: .9; }
[data-theme="dark"] .hero-bg { opacity: .12; filter: saturate(1.4); }
.hero-bg::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--page) 30%, transparent 75%); }
.hero-in { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap: 40px; align-items: center; }
.row-btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 28px; }
.scroll-hint { position: absolute; bottom: 18px; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-3);
  opacity: calc(1 - var(--p, 0) * 3); }

.phone { justify-self: center; width: min(320px, 78vw); aspect-ratio: 9 / 18.5; border-radius: 44px; padding: 10px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #2a2d34, #0d0e12); box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(16,24,40,.25); }
.phone-screen { position: relative; height: 100%; border-radius: 36px; overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto auto; padding: 22px 18px 26px;
  background: radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 55%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) calc(var(--p, 0) * 22%), var(--page)), var(--page)); }
.ph-top { align-self: start; }
.pill-state { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-wash) calc(var(--p, 0) * 100%), var(--surface-alt));
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-ink) calc(var(--p, 0) * 100%), var(--text-3)); }
.pill-state .dot { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) calc(var(--p, 0) * 100%), var(--text-4)); }
.pill-state [data-on] { display: none; }
.hero[data-on="1"] .pill-state [data-on] { display: inline; }
.hero[data-on="1"] .pill-state [data-off] { display: none; }
.ph-mascot { position: relative; width: 110px; height: 110px; }
.ph-mascot img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; transition: opacity var(--t-state), transform var(--t-state) var(--ease); }
.ph-mascot .m-on { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.9); }
.hero[data-on="1"] .ph-mascot .m-on { opacity: 1; transform: none; animation: hop 1.8s var(--ease) infinite; }
.hero[data-on="1"] .ph-mascot .m-off { opacity: 0; }
@keyframes hop { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px); } }
.hero-power { --size: 132px; position: relative; z-index: 2;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) calc(var(--p, 0) * 100%), #FFFFFF),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-ink) calc(var(--p, 0) * 100%), #F2F3F5) 70%);
  color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff calc(var(--p, 0) * 100%), #3A3F47);
  animation-play-state: paused; }
.hero[data-on="1"] .hero-power { animation-play-state: running; }
.power-wrap { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; margin: 8px 0 22px; }
.ph-rings { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; pointer-events: none; }
.ph-rings i { position: absolute; width: 132px; height: 132px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--accent); opacity: 0; }
.hero[data-on="1"] .ph-rings i { animation: ring 2.4s ease-out infinite; }
.hero[data-on="1"] .ph-rings i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .8s; }
.hero[data-on="1"] .ph-rings i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 1.6s; }
@keyframes ring { from { transform: scale(1); opacity: .5; } to { transform: scale(2.3); opacity: 0; } }
.ph-bottom { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-self: end; }
.chip { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-2); }

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .hero { height: 190vh; }
  .hero-in { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; text-align: center; }
  .hero-in .lead { margin: 0 auto; }
  .row-btns { justify-content: center; }
  .hero-bg::after { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--page) 35%, transparent 90%); }
  .phone { width: min(230px, 62vw); }
  .hero-power { --size: 100px; }
  .ph-mascot { width: 84px; height: 84px; }
  .phone-screen { padding: 16px 12px; gap: 6px; }
  .chip { font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 9px; }
  .scroll-hint { display: none; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hero { height: auto; } .hero-sticky { position: relative; height: auto; padding: 48px 0; } }

/* features */
.grid3 { display: grid; gap: 16px; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin-top: 32px; }
@media (max-width: 960px) { .grid3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .grid3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.grid3:has(> .plan:only-child) { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 440px); justify-content: center; }
.feat h3::before { content: ""; display: block; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px;
  background: var(--accent-wash) url("@@asset10@@") center / 22px no-repeat; }

/* Porty bands */
.porty-band { padding: 48px 0; }
.band-in { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; align-items: center; }
.band-in img, img.mid { border-radius: var(--radius); }
/* the app's Light art sits on white: multiply melts it into the page, as the app's cards do */
[data-theme="light"] .band-in img, [data-theme="light"] img.mid { mix-blend-mode: multiply; }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .band-in { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .rev .band-in > div:first-child { order: 2; } }

/* stores */
.stores { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 20px; }
.store { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--text); color: var(--page);
  text-decoration: none !important; min-width: 200px; transition: transform var(--t-state) var(--ease); }
.store:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.store svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
.store span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.2; }
.store small { font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; opacity: .75; }
.store.big { min-width: 260px; padding: 14px 22px; }

/* plans */
.plan { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.plan .price { font-size: 18px; color: var(--text); margin: 6px 0 8px; }
.plan .price b { font-size: 40px; font-weight: 800; }
.plan .btn { margin-top: 16px; align-self: flex-start; }

/* faq, steps, legal */
.qa { margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 0; }
.qa summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 20px 24px; font-weight: 700; list-style: none; }
.qa summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.qa summary::after { content: "+"; float: right; color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 800; }
.qa[open] summary::after { content: "\2013"; }
.qa p { padding: 0 24px 20px; margin: 0; }
.steps { padding-left: 48px; }
.steps li { margin: 8px 0; color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }
.legal h2 { font-size: 22px; margin-top: 32px; }
.legal p, .legal li { color: var(--text-2); }

/* footer */

(function () {

    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));

      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);

  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");

    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();

  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");

(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });

    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }

  if (menu && nav) menu.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");

})();

(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }
  var menu = document.querySelector(".menu"), nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
  if (menu && nav) menu.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");
    menu.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
  });
})();
</script>

<script>/* WEB_SITE_V1 - the hero connects as the visitor scrolls (--p 0..1, data-on past 60 %), the mobile menu. */
(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }
  var menu = document.querySelector(".menu"), nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
  if (menu && nav) menu.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");
    menu.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
  });
})();
</script>

(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }
  var menu = document.querySelector(".menu"), nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
  if (menu && nav) menu.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");
    menu.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
  });
})();
</script>

(function () {

  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });

    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }

<style>/* WEB_BASE_V1 - the app's type, cards and buttons on the web. Colours only via tokens.css (from AppPalette).

@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 600; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset8@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 700; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset8@@") format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Noto Sans Myanmar VP"; font-weight: 800; font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+1000-109F, U+A9E0-A9FF, U+AA60-AA7F, U+200C-200D, U+25CC; src: url("@@asset9@@") format("woff2"); }

.power {

/* cards entering as the app's home: 560 ms + 160 ms per card */
.enter { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }

(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }
  var menu = document.querySelector(".menu"), nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
  if (menu && nav) menu.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");

  });
})();

(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });

    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }
  var menu = document.querySelector(".menu"), nav = document.querySelector(".nav");

  });
})();

(function () {

    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();

It encrypts your connection and sends it through our servers in Asia, so apps and sites work fast and your network cannot see what you do. One tap connects you; the app picks the best server and route by itself.</p></div></details><details class="card qa"><summary>Which devices does it work on?</summary><div class="qa-a"><p>iPhone and iPad, Android phones and tablets, Mac and Windows. Get it from the App Store, Google Play or the Microsoft Store: see <a href="#page-download">Download</a>. The app speaks English, Burmese, Thai and Chinese.</p></div></details><details class="card qa"><summary>How do I sign in?</summary><div class="qa-a"><p>With Apple (on iPhone, iPad and Mac), with Google, or with your username and password. <script>/* WEB_SITE_V1 - the hero connects as the visitor scrolls (--p 0..1, data-on past 60 %), the mobile menu. */
(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }
  var menu = document.querySelector(".menu"), nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
  if (menu && nav) menu.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");
    menu.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
  });
})();
</script>

<script>/* WEB_SITE_V1 - the hero connects as the visitor scrolls (--p 0..1, data-on past 60 %), the mobile menu. */
(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector("[data-hero]");
  if (hero) {
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    var tick = false;
    function update() {
      tick = false;
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      var span = hero.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
      var p = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / Math.max(1, span * 0.7)));
      hero.style.setProperty("--p", p.toFixed(3));
      hero.setAttribute("data-on", p > 0.62 ? "1" : "0");
      hero.setAttribute("data-step", p > 0.62 ? "3" : p > 0.38 ? "2" : p > 0.12 ? "1" : "0");
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    update();
  }
  // WEB_SITE_V3: smooth reveals (.reveal, .enter), once each
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .enter, .page-head .wrap, .plan, .qa, .stores");
  els.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains("enter")) el.classList.add("reveal"); });
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("in"); }); }
  var menu = document.querySelector(".menu"), nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
  if (menu && nav) menu.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");
    menu.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
  });
})();
